reviews.title: 7- day free trial
reviews.text:
I signed up for Norton VPN because you advertised a 7-day free trial. However, within just a few minutes of signing up, you attempted to charge me for an entire year of service.

What is the point of offering a 7-day free trial if you’re going to attempt to charge customers immediately?

This is completely unacceptable and misleading. I expect an explanation and confirmation that I will not be charged for an annual subscription during the advertised trial period. If a charge has already been processed, I expect a full refund.

reviews.title: The worst VPN
reviews.text: I've used many VPNs, and this is the worst one I've ever tried. The connection drops constantly, or it doesn't connect at all. It freezes and breaks far too often, and the speed is also very slow. It's clearly full of bugs and fails so frequently that it's practically unusable. Norton also takes a very long time to update the app and fix these problems, and when a new version finally comes out, it often brings even more bugs. In the end, the app is useless. I don't recommend Norton VPN, and you're better off trying another one, like I did. I no longer have any of the problems I had before.

reviews.title: Nothing but problems
reviews.text:
Good VPN if you want total unreliable connection. Especially good if you like constantly restarting your phone to get it to work. Fantastic app if you like the uncertainty of will the website open or will it be stuck on trying to load the page. Even better if you like to roll the dice thinking the connection is secure only to find it’s switched itself off. 

Thanks for your response. I’m in the UK using Uk websites with a UK server selected. I can’t even open the App Store with the VPN switched on. All this is recent after a IOS update. I have tried uninstalling, switching phone off and reinstalling. It works for an hour then is intermittent. Even tried mimic connection and that worked for a while before deciding it had had enough. I too as a paying customer have decided they have had enough and when it comes to renewing my Norton anti virus package I will be taking my money elsewhere after decades of loyal customer support. Oh and by the way how come your response is reading 4y ago instead of days.
